data.narrative:
Cohesive Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $5M+ to date. The comparable universe includes one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI. However, the peer set lacks sufficient density at equivalent stage and valuation tier to support median-based triangulation.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable methodology here. Using total capital raised ($5M) as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $12M. This method reflects the expected step-change in valuation when moving from Seed to Series A or equivalent milestone, contingent on execution.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median point of $12M. The range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties center on the thinness of the peer sample at this specific stage and geography, and the absence of recent transaction multiples in this subsector. Any valuation near these levels should be stress-tested against founder track record, product-market fit indicators, and capital efficiency relative to the identified peer set.
